mK discards the return value of process.kill and returns true on success or false on an exception; this establishes a process-existence probe, rather than a falsiness comparison of the API result (s3; s4; f1:1).
The lock file supplies a PID to a signal-0 liveness probe, which checks for a running process (s3; f1:1).
